channel.title: Madeira through my eyes
channel.description: Igor Kartuzov, an entrepreneur in Funchal, is writing a science-fiction novel about Madeira. The diary: how the work goes and which places on the island make it into the chapters. Twice a week.

item.title: Christmas arrives ahead of the calendar
item.description: In Nuremberg the season is in full swing: the stalls glow, gingerbread hearts hang over the counters, the Ferris wheel lights up the square, and on the old tower an angel made of lights spreads its wings.

item.title: Report on an experiment
item.description: In my last entry I promised to look for fresh ideas in Nuremberg — over sausages and beer. Here is my report.

item.title: I opened the Library
item.description: It is raining in Mariánské Lázně.

item.title: Madeira from afar
item.description: I'm writing these lines in Mariánské Lázně, the old Marienbad.

item.title: Gone for two weeks to write a book about Madeira
item.description: I'm 56, I'm an entrepreneur, and today I left for two weeks to write a book about Madeira.
